annotations.text: Hickeyfield redesign, one direction: dense dark studio. Layout only borrows the shape of modern generation studios (use-case nav, stage, tile pickers, sticky generate); every string and image here is original placeholder art. Tokens keep the vermilion brand; type scale gets used.

For you to mark up: 1) stage-first Studio vs. the old results feed; 2) 72px icon nav vs. a labelled 200px nav; 3) hide the meta rail on Studio or keep it; 4) anything in the Tokens table you would not change.
